about: The 9 mistakes Uzbek speakers make (docs/ideas/mistake-engine.md). why = the one line in Uzbek shown under the correct answer when an item with this trap is missed.

traps.name: Missing "am"
traps.why: O'zbek tilida «-man» qo'shimchasi bor: Men Azizman. Ingliz tilida u alohida so'z — am: I am Aziz → I'm Aziz.

traps.name: a / an
traps.why: O'zbek tilida artikl yo'q. Bitta narsa oldidan a qo'yiladi: a coffee. So'z unli tovush bilan boshlansa — an: an orange juice.

traps.name: Plural after numbers
traps.why: O'zbekchada «ikkita qahva» deymiz. Ingliz tilida birdan ko'p bo'lsa -s qo'shiladi: two coffees.

traps.name: "no" for negation
traps.why: O'zbekchada inkor fe'lga qo'shiladi: xohlamayman. Ingliz tilida don't ishlatiladi: I don't want sugar. Qisqasi: No sugar, please.

traps.name: Thanks you
traps.why: Thank you yoki Thanks deymiz. Thanks you — ikkalasini aralashtirmang.

traps.name: Question without "Do"
traps.why: O'zbekchada savol «-mi» bilan yasaladi: Sizda suv bormi? Ingliz tilida savol boshiga Do qo'yiladi: Do you have water?

traps.name: Missing "is"
traps.why: O'zbekchada «Bu qancha?» deymiz — fe'lsiz. Ingliz tilida is kerak: How much is this?

traps.name: very / too
traps.why: O'zbekchada «juda katta» ikki ma'noda. Ingliz tilida: very big — juda katta; too big — haddan tashqari katta, to'g'ri kelmaydi.

traps.name: fifteen / fifty
traps.why: fifTEEN (15) — urg'u oxirida, cho'ziq «i». FIFty (50) — urg'u boshida.
